comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: pre-flight line captures the wrong workspace when `config.workingDir` is set**

`collectPreflightStateStep()` (this call site, step 1.4) runs **before** `checkoutBranchOrReport()` (step 2) — but `_workingDir` is assigned only inside `checkoutBranch()` (`js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:330`), which is reached in step 2. At capture time `_workingDir` is still `null`, so `runCommandStr` → `runCmd` executes `git rev-parse` / `git status --porcelain` in the **process cwd (the agents repo)**, not in the configured target repository.

Consequence: for every dynamic-repo/`workingDir` setup (the mode `test_preCliDevelopmentSetupDynamicRepo.js` exists for), the `git pre-flight: branch=… head=… dirty=… staged=… paths=[…]` line in the failure report describes the agents checkout — where the leg never ran — instead of the target workspace the report is about. A post-hoc reader gets a confidently wrong `branch=`/`head=` (misleading diagnostics are worse than an omitted line, which the module already supports via `preflightLine(null)`).

Note the failure path itself is affected too: `checkoutBranch` sets `_workingDir` before failing, so the setup-error comment posts the stale wrong-workspace pre-flight line captured at step 1.4.

Suggested fix: resolve `config.workingDir` (from the already-loaded `config` at this point in `action()`) into `_workingDir` — or pass it explicitly to `collectPreflightStateStep(config.workingDir)` and thread it through `runCmd` — before the capture, and add a `workingDir` test asserting the pre-flight commands carry `workingDirectory` (the existing test at `test_preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` only covers the no-workingDir case).

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `--argjson priorBodies` ships the whole comment history through argv — E2BIG past 128 KiB, contradicting this script's own rule**

The header of this script states: *"Payload bytes travel via stdin (never argv — E2BIG past 128 KiB, the same rule the token-usage publisher learned)"*. This line then puts the **largest payload component** — `PRIOR_BODIES`, i.e. every comment body on the issue (`gh issue view --json comments`) — on the jq command line as a single `--argjson` argv entry.

Demonstrated on Linux (`MAX_ARG_STRLEN` = 128 KiB): a ~140 KB array makes jq fail with `Argument list too long`. The failure is swallowed by `|| echo '{}'`, so the notice silently degrades to the bare-link fallback — **exactly on the issues where the feature matters most**: repeat-count context only renders when prior failure comments exist, and each failure cycle grows the history (this repo's issues routinely carry multi-KB bot notices, so 128 KiB is reachable within tens of comments).

Fix options (all keep `gh` output on non-argv channels):

```bash
# process substitution + --slurpfile: data never touches argv
jq -n --arg workflow "${WORKFLOW_FILE:-ai-teammate.yml}" ... \
  --slurpfile priorBodies <(printf '%s' "$PRIOR_BODIES") \
  '{...} * {priorBodies: $priorBodies[0]}'
```

or fold `PRIOR_BODIES` into the stdin JSON the node program already reads (`env.priorBodies`), dropping `--argjson` entirely. A regression test can pin it by piping a >128 KiB fixture through the payload build.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: empty `OUTCOME` is reported as "run success" — a missing env var fabricates a success notice**

`[ -z "$OUTCOME" ]` routes to the success branch and posts `🤖 AI Teammate run success: <url>`. If the future workflow flip forgets to wire `OUTCOME`, every failed leg would post a **false success comment** — the worst possible diagnostic, and it contradicts the PR's own "never guessed" principle (the repeat line is omitted when unknown rather than guessed).

Safer contract: post the historical line only for a real `success`; for an empty/unknown outcome either skip the notice (with a `::warning::`) or post the bare-link line with the empty outcome left visible so the misconfiguration is obvious:

```bash
case "$OUTCOME" in
  success) ... post bare link ... ;;
  "") echo "::warning::report-leg-failure: OUTCOME unset — notice skipped"; exit 0 ;;
esac
```

`NUMBER`-unset already degrades to a warning + exit 0; the same pattern fits here.

`leg_failure_outcome_line` has two layers: the node path renders `outcomeLine(outcome, '')` → `🤖 AI Teammate run failure: <run-url-unavailable>`, but the plain-shell fallback (`printf '🤖 AI Teammate run %s: %s' "$1" "$2"`) prints an empty `%s` when `RUN_URL` is unset — `🤖 AI Teammate run failure: ` with nothing after the colon. comments.author: ajaxspace
comments.body:
Pre-merge spec review (vs #1363 + epic #1362):

**Verified in the diff** ✅ — shared builder `legFailureReport.js` serving both flavors;
report carries the pre-flight state line, phase, failing step, run id + link, hard-capped
excerpt (`EXCERPT_MAX_LINES = 30`, re-trimmed in the renderer so callers can't exceed),
repeat phrase only at count ≥ 2; pure signature normalizer (`workflow | step | normalized
message`) with the repeat count derived from `failure-signature:` lines in prior failure
comments (no new persistence — clean approach); in-leg integration enriched
(`preCliDevelopmentSetup` setup-error comments); CLI `scripts/report-leg-failure.sh`
shipped via the release packs with safe degradation.

**Three review points:**

1. **BLOCKING — `crap` check FAILURE.** A new function exceeds the CRAP ≤ 8 threshold
   (the gate log names it). Split/simplify per the #1360 precedent.

2. **UNVERIFIED CLAIM — "sessionDelta UT-3 AC3 fails identically on clean f3183be
   (pre-existing, unrelated)".** I ran the full `run_all.json` on clean `main` under the
   local dmtools runtime: **8547 passed, 0 failed** — no sessionDelta failure reproduces
   here. If the failure is real in the CI runtime (dmtools v0.1.88 GraalJS), re-verify it
   on the CI runner WITHOUT your changes and name the exact divergence; if it does not
   fail there either, it is a regression from this PR and must be fixed before merge.

3. **SCOPE — the workflow-side failure path is not wired yet.** The spec called for the
   shared builder on BOTH failure paths; this PR ships the CLI + pack registration, but
   the engine-side factory workflow (the poster of the bare `AI Teammate run failure:`
   link) is outside this repo, so nothing calls `report-leg-failure.sh` yet. Agreed this
   is the correct repo boundary — but it must be TRACKED: an issue for the engine-side
   flip (owner repo) so the workflow path doesn't stay bare forever.

Points 1-2 are merge blockers; point 3 needs a tracking issue, not a code change.

comments.author: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
comments.body:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The `crap` quality gate is red on this PR: three new functions in `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` exceed the CRAP>8 new-code threshold (`postSetupErrorComment` 13, `deriveSetupRepeatCount` 10, `readEnvVar` 9). Two important issues: the gh-1363 pre-flight line captures the wrong workspace when `config.workingDir` is set (capture runs before `_workingDir` is assigned), and `report-leg-failure.sh` ships the entire prior-comment history through jq's argv — E2BIG past 128 KiB, contradicting the script's own payload rule and silently dropping repeat-count enrichment on exactly the recurring-failure issues it targets. The builder itself (`legFailureReport.js`) is clean, pure, well-tested, and AC-conformant.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 crap ratchet red — 3 new functions over threshold (CI failure on `bfa60a51`)
- ⚠️ pre-flight line reads the agents repo instead of the target repo under `workingDir` (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:891` vs `:330`)
- ⚠️ `--argjson priorBodies` argv payload violates the stdin rule (`report-leg-failure.sh:138`)
- 💡 `--self-test` advertised in the PR but not implemented · setup-path excerpt duplicates the `Error:` line · empty `OUTCOME` fabricates a success notice · pack-carry suite is substring-grep only
- 🪶 printf fallback drops `<run-url-unavailable>` · `renderReport` renders `Phase: undefined`

**Digest**: `js/unit-tests/test_workingDir.js` — `legFailureReport` stub entries added to `loadModule` maps of modules that never require it (`configLoader`/`outputFiles` paths) — dead stub entries, harmless but noise.

**Next Steps**:
1. Split `postSetupErrorComment` / `deriveSetupRepeatCount` / `readEnvVar` into small helpers (gh-1042 extraction pattern) to bring each under CRAP 8 — unblocks CI
2. Resolve the target-repo `workingDir` before capturing pre-flight state; add a workingDir-path test
3. Feed `priorBodies` to jq via `--slurpfile`/stdin, never argv
4. Implement (or drop) the advertised `bash scripts/report-leg-failure.sh --self-test`
